maddeler.e:
نرتفع (form VIII)
# نَرْتَفِعُ (nartafiʕu) /nar.ta.fi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
# نَرْتَفِعَ (nartafiʕa) /nar.ta.fi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
# نَرْتَفِعْ (nartafiʕ) /nar.ta.fiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِرْتَفَعَ (irtafaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
